description: A multi_match full-text clause — a match run across several columns at once.

query.description: Required. The text to match across the listed columns. A string.

fields.description: Required. The columns to search. Each entry may carry a ^boost suffix (e.g. title^2).

type.description: Optional. How the per-field matches are combined: best_fields (default), most_fields, cross_fields, phrase, phrase_prefix, or bool_prefix.

operator.description: Optional. Boolean logic used to combine the analyzed terms: or (default) or and.

tie_breaker.description: Optional. Weight (0–1) applied to non-best field scores in best_fields / cross_fields.

max_expansions.description: Optional. Maximum number of terms a fuzzy / prefix expansion will generate. Default 50.

slop.description: Optional. Number of positions allowed between matching terms for the phrase types.

cutoff_frequency.description: Optional. Term-frequency threshold above which terms are treated as low-importance.

auto_generate_synonyms_phrase_query.description: Optional. Whether to auto-generate phrase queries for multi-term synonyms. Default true.

lenient.description: Optional. When true, format-based errors are ignored.
